non_implementation_rules: Do not create source_proxy/cognitive modules until an authorized implementation phase.
Do not replace existing decision, verifier, approval, or coding runner systems without identifying the weak contract.
Do not add preview endpoints unless tests, UI, or evidence reports use them.
Do not start Phase 2 memory or Obsidian work from Phase 1.
